subject: I made a secret feature just for you
preview_text: I wasn't planning to share this, but here's something extra I built to surprise your partner.
body_paragraphs: Remember that time you were scrambling for a date idea and ended up at the same old pizza place? I've been there, and it got me thinking. So I coded something on the side, a little bonus I wasn't going to release yet, but I think you'll love it.

It's a new tool inside SoulPlan that lets you create a surprise date in under 30 seconds. You pick a vibe, a budget, and a time, and it secretly plans everything for your partner to discover. The idea is to break the routine when you least expect it.

This isn't a big official update—it's more like a hidden gem I'm slipping in for early users like you. When you open the app, look for the 'Surprise Date' card on your dashboard. It's not for everyone, but for couples who want that extra spark, it's gold.
Try it out this week and see their face when they unlock it. I bet it'll make their day. P.S. Only 230 people have access to this so far, so don't share it just yet.
